meta.name: azure-reliability
meta.description: Assess and improve the reliability posture of PaaS Applications (Azure Functions and Azure App Service). Scans deployed resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist, then drives staged remediation (CLI or IaC patches) end-to-end with user confirmation. WHEN: "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", "high availability", "disaster recovery", "single points of failure", "reliability posture", "resiliency".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描并修复 Azure PaaS 应用的可靠性问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责 Azure 上应用的高可用与灾备配置。
copy.tagline_en: Scan and fix reliability issues in Azure PaaS apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage high availability and disaster recovery for Azure apps.

howto.what: 扫描你的 Azure Functions 和 App Service 资源，检查区域冗余、存储冗余、健康探测和多区域故障转移等可靠性特性，然后生成一个按特性分组的检查清单，并引导你逐步修复发现的问题。
howto.when: 当你提到“评估可靠性”、“检查区域冗余”、“多区域故障转移”、“高可用性”、“灾难恢复”、“单点故障”、“可靠性状态”或“弹性”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我评估我的 Function App 的可靠性。
say.note: 技能会扫描指定资源并生成可靠性检查清单。

say.text: 检查我的 Web 应用是否启用了区域冗余。
say.note: 技能会检查 App Service 的区域冗余配置。

say.text: 为我的应用设置多区域故障转移。
say.note: 技能会引导你完成多区域配置。

howto.what_en: Scans your Azure Functions and App Service resources for reliability features like zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist and guides you through staged remediation with user confirmation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", "high availability", "disaster recovery", "single points of failure", "reliability posture", or "resiliency".

say_en.text: Assess the reliability of my Function App.
say_en.note: The skill scans the resource and generates a reliability checklist.

say_en.text: Check if my web app is zone redundant.
say_en.note: The skill checks zone redundancy configuration for App Service.

say_en.text: Set up multi-region failover for my app.
say_en.note: The skill guides you through multi-region configuration.
